definitions.gloss: zero points; zero marks; a score of zero
definitions.explanation: A score of zero on a test, exam, or evaluation. Also used figuratively to mean something is completely unacceptable or worthless.

examples.japanese: ⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{零点|れいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I got zero on the test.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{忘|わす}れたら→書き忘れる：28241_kakiwasureru⟧{零点|れいてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you forget to write your name, you'll get zero points.

examples.japanese: ⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}し→関する：02045_kansuru⟧ては{零点|れいてん}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧だ。
examples.english: His manners are a zero, but his work skills are solid.

notes:
Most commonly associated with academic tests and exams. Also used figuratively as a harsh evaluation meaning "completely failing" in some area. The kanji ⟦{零|れい}→零：00983_rei⟧ is the formal character for zero.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {零点|れいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to get zero points
- {零点|れいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to give zero points
- {零点|れいてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to end up with zero

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: zero points — uses the loanword ⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧; more casual
- ⟦{満点|まんてん}→満点：03156_manten⟧: perfect score — the opposite, getting all points
- {赤点|あかてん}: failing mark — a score below the passing threshold, but not necessarily zero
